title: Dr. Bing Zhou Joins UTK Geography Department as Tenure-Track Assistant Professor
summary: We are excited to welcome Dr. Bing Zhou to the Department of Geography and Sustainability at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville. Dr. Zhou will lead the newly established GRIND Lab.
